use: One borrowed typed relative-offset decoder shared by Title Catalog and immutable nine-group resource selection. Resource decoding is not native runtime, renderer, installation, application, hardware or full-game acceptance. No GAME source bodies, ROM bytecode, images or palettes are distributed.

facts: Script/image table entries and frame/palette pointers are relative to their section base. Source mutates each image descriptor's pointer table once per descriptor table entry: duplicate image descriptors would double-relocate and are rejected; script descriptor aliases and frame/palette payload aliases retain borrowed address identity.

Particle bytecodePos and the single returnPtr initialize to zero. FA overwrites one loop pointer and eight-bit count; FB decrements with byte wrap, so FA00 executes256 iterations. FC replaces one return pointer; FD is not a call stack. Only the completely decoded nonzero wait yields. FE/FF terminate. Loop state before the first FA is not initialized by creation, and reachable FB-before-FA is rejected rather than inventing initial source values.

Float operands are byte-packed: decoder reframes checked four bytes and calls GuestView::f32(0), never unaligned casts or weakened aligned-record scalar reads. All descriptor/operand floats must be finite.

A4/A5/B9 and AA references are bank-local; AA zero range still selects its base. Wait/BC frame bounds use the script's selected image. B7/B8 address the separately declared single target slot0, while BF selects separate output slots1..8.

CI pointer palette count tests flags&1; source emitter shared-palette flag tests flags!=0. Decoder retains the original flags without conflating those tests. CI4 palettes are exactly16 RGBA16 entries,32 bytes: the existing native legalization is preserved rather than exposing source pal256 overread bytes.

decoder_contract.format_extent: ceil(width*height*(4<<size_code)/8), all products/additions checked; only evidenced format/size combinations; dimensions nonzero and payloads bounded by the entire image section, not adjacent descriptors. No Title frame/dimension ceiling or forced GPU address.
decoder_contract.relative_records: Preserve original table order. Script extent is the next greater distinct descriptor start or section end; duplicate script starts retain header/bytecode address identity. Descriptor/pointer tables cannot overlap each other or payloads; payload aliases remain borrowed. Reachable instruction extents cannot overlap or cross the bounded script record.
decoder_contract.state_graph: Deterministic source control trajectory over(pc,loopPointer,count8,returnPointer), initialpc0/return0 and undefined loop untilFA. Raw in-tick pc is a byte-pointer offset; only FA loopPtr, FC returnPtr and nonzero-wait saved bytecodePos narrow tou16 exactly at source assignments. This is not a bytecode-length cap. Every reached instruction is framed/operand-validated. Exact per-tick state repetition rejects non-yielding cycles; repetition across decoded nonzero waits certifies a periodic yielding trajectory. Single loop and return registers persist across waits. No lexical-wait shortcut, nesting assumption, instruction cap or arbitrary exploration cutoff. A7's possible death is not used to justify a potentially hanging continuation. Unreachable terminal padding is excluded. Script header textureID is checked asu16 for emitter image-flag access, then narrowed tou8 for particle selected-image frame validation; BC frame ranges preserveu8 wrap.
decoder_contract.limits: Resource stage admits descriptor kinds0/3 for this selected closure; runtime must independently prove every reached opcode, scene flags/physics, immediate child allocation/ordering, attachment/target services and bank lifetimes. Control proof is per interpreter invocation, not a claim about recursively spawned children, RNG, complete source scene setup or application readiness. Resource vectors allocate at decoding only; borrowed views remain immutable afterward.
decoder_contract.errors: EffectResourceError carries menu::Status(error,address); address is section guest identity when supplied, otherwise exact ROM/author extent identity. Malformed encoding/references/control flow uses malformed, escaped/overflowed extents use extent, invalid/moved Snapshot uses invalid_snapshot. Allocation failures propagate. Title translates the typed error into its existing hydrate Status; no partial Catalog publication.
decoder_contract.lifetime: Generic callers retain both section storage owners. EffectResources requires an admitted const lvalue Snapshot, forbids copy/move and rvalue Snapshot construction, and checks Snapshot data identity/extent on every bank/installation_spans access. Snapshot must outlive selector and all exported references; destruction cannot be detected through a dangling C++ reference. Scene must retain owners and installations through actual GPU submission completion. Moving Snapshot invalidates access, not already-returned raw C++ views.
decoder_contract.installation: Per-group sorted merged union of original frame/palette borrowed extents, no descriptor/code bytes and no duplicated image bytes or forced addresses. Scene chooses active resource slots, packs/relocates legal GPU bindings, checks reservations/TMEM/packet capacity and fences real completion separately.
